verses.text: My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you,
lines: My son, if you will receive my words,
and store up my commandments within you,

verses.text: so as to turn your ear to wisdom, and apply your heart to understanding;
lines: so as to turn your ear to wisdom,
and apply your heart to understanding;

verses.text: yes, if you call out for discernment, and lift up your voice for understanding;
lines: yes, if you call out for discernment,
and lift up your voice for understanding;

verses.text: if you seek her as silver, and search for her as for hidden treasures:
lines: if you seek her as silver,
and search for her as for hidden treasures:

verses.text: then you will understand the fear of Yahweh, and find the knowledge of God.
lines: then you will understand the fear of Yahweh,
and find the knowledge of God.

verses.text: For Yahweh gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.
lines: For Yahweh gives wisdom.
Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.

verses.text: He lays up sound wisdom for the upright. He is a shield to those who walk in integrity,
lines: He lays up sound wisdom for the upright.
He is a shield to those who walk in integrity,

verses.text: that he may guard the paths of justice, and preserve the way of his saints.
lines: that he may guard the paths of justice,
and preserve the way of his saints.

verses.text: Then you will understand righteousness and justice, equity and every good path.
lines: Then you will understand righteousness and justice,
equity and every good path.

verses.text: For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.
lines: For wisdom will enter into your heart.
Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.

verses.text: Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you,
lines: Discretion will watch over you.
Understanding will keep you,

verses.text: to deliver you from the way of evil, from the men who speak perverse things,
lines: to deliver you from the way of evil,
from the men who speak perverse things,

verses.text: who forsake the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness,
lines: who forsake the paths of uprightness,
to walk in the ways of darkness,

verses.text: who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the perverseness of evil,
lines: who rejoice to do evil,
and delight in the perverseness of evil,

verses.text: who are crooked in their ways, and wayward in their paths,
lines: who are crooked in their ways,
and wayward in their paths,

verses.text: to deliver you from the strange woman, even from the foreigner who flatters with her words,
lines: to deliver you from the strange woman,
even from the foreigner who flatters with her words,

verses.text: who forsakes the friend of her youth, and forgets the covenant of her God;
lines: who forsakes the friend of her youth,
and forgets the covenant of her God;

verses.text: for her house leads down to death, her paths to the departed spirits.
lines: for her house leads down to death,
her paths to the departed spirits.

verses.text: None who go to her return again, neither do they attain to the paths of life.
lines: None who go to her return again,
neither do they attain to the paths of life.

verses.text: So you may walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.
lines: So you may walk in the way of good men,
and keep the paths of the righteous.

verses.text: For the upright will dwell in the land. The perfect will remain in it.
lines: For the upright will dwell in the land.
The perfect will remain in it.

verses.text: But the wicked will be cut off from the land. The treacherous will be rooted out of it.
lines: But the wicked will be cut off from the land.
The treacherous will be rooted out of it.
